scope_summary: Implemented design sections 4-8, 10, and 11 only: additive reply-keyboard fields for GetInlineMenu, authoritative chat reply-markup pointer resolution, transport menu-kind dispatch, generated protobuf, and manual test matrix updates.

changes.intent: Add MenuKind, ReplyButton, ReplyButtonRow and InlineMenuResponse fields 3-8 without changing existing fields or RPCs.
Regenerate protobuf bindings from the additive facade.proto changes and verify reproducibility.
Add GetChat to the partial repo interface and resolve message_id=0 through chat.reply_markup_message_id before retaining GetChatHistory(limit=1) fallback.
Add the GetChat mock in the existing generated mockery style without regeneration.
Dispatch on message reply markup: inline, reply keyboard, or NONE; map reply rows, button types, web app URLs, and keyboard attributes while preserving order and skipping nil buttons.
Cover explicit-id GetChat avoidance, reply-markup pointer 777, empty-pointer history fallback, empty history error, and GetChat error propagation with strict mocks.
Cover reply keyboard mapping including message_id backfill, rows, types, web app URL, attributes, nil-button skip, inline kind additions, and NONE for remove/force markup.
Update GRPC-U-002 and manual live bot entries to cover inline, reply, and no-menu results.

test_notes: Scoped commands run with -p 2: go build for grpc/facade/cmd, go vet and go test for grpc/facade/telegram, and gofmt on changed Go files; all returned successfully. Protoc regeneration was idempotent. A temporary controlled removal of the reply-mapping branch made the reply tests fail; production files were restored and verified.
